PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme for Advanced Pregnant Lifter"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build strength during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing_quadriceps_stretch 3m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          arm_ergometer 6m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_dumbbell_shoulder_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_biceps_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_opener_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m

        cooldown:

        cooldown:

  PHASE "Strength & Stability" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body & Core":

          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_cable_abduction 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing_hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body & Core":

        cooldown:
